items.title: The fact that @basketballpoetry.com picked Jordan Miller as 1 of their 4 breakout players next season makes me feel seen 🥹
items.author: Leo S
items.body_excerpt: The fact that @basketballpoetry.com picked Jordan Miller as 1 of their 4 breakout players next season makes me feel seen 🥹

images.alt:
Miller does fun stuff all the time.

Almost half of his shots came at the rim, a number more suitable for an old-school power forward than a 6’5” shooting guard, and he completed a gobsmacking 71%. Defenders could only resort to fouling him, which they did on an absurd 18% of his shot attempts (more than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander!).
